extraction.Name: Charlys Whipple
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded on April 27, 1918, by R. E. Wang
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged the land April 25, 1918, for $900.00, and on May 4, 1920, transferred the same by deed to Alexander Whipple for a consideration of $4500.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612703 issued; Southwest quarter of Section 29, Township 39, north of range 32; receipt for patent signed in February 1918
